proposal.summary: There is a vulnerability in MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 that can be exploited to bypass authentication.

AV.quote: A remote attacker might access the system if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the random value generation mechanism in the web service authenticator.

evidence_quotes.quote: A remote attacker might access the system if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.
